Secondary marking of bullet

Secondary markings or individual characteristics are produced on the surface of the bullet by imperfection on the inner surface of the barrel.

As they are specific to the firearm from which It's fired. Hence ,also called the Bullet fingerprint.

questions.stem: An 18-year-old girl was brought to OPD, labia majora separated, labia minora flabby, fourchette tear present and vagina is roomy but hymen is intact. What could be possible?
questions.solutionHtml:
False virgin

As patient Labia majora is separated, labia minora is flabby with presence of roomy vagina and tear in fourchette suggest that Patient has experienced sexual intercourse.

With Intact hymen suggests False virgin.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 392.

questions.stem: In a rape case, swab collection can be done till how many days after the incident:
questions.solutionHtml:
4 days

If a woman reports within 96 hours (4 days) of sexual assault, all swabs based on the nature of assault are collected.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 416.

questions.stem: If any request is made for medical records either by the patient/authorized attendant or legal authorities involved, the same may be duly acknowledged and documents shall be issued within the period of:
questions.solutionHtml:
72 hrs
  • As per Code of Medical Ethics by MCI, every physician shall maintain the medical records of indoor patients for a period of 3 years from the date of commencement of the treatment in a standard prescribed format.
  • If any request is made either by the patients/authorized attendants or legal authorities involved, the records shall be issued within 72 hours.
  • If the medical records are not issued, it amounts to misconduct.


KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 27.

questions.stemHtml: A female was found dead in her bedroom. The room was not locked from inside. Blood value of alcohol was 350 mg/dL. With an image of face, open neck, and viscera. Likely cause of death is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Throttling

Picture shows bruises on neck (likely 6 penny bruises) and cyanosed lip with The neck showing soft tissue ecchymosis typical of Throttling.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 352.

questions.stemHtml: A patient presents with concentric teeth bite marks on the forearm. What should be done next?

options.label: B
options.text: Keep scale for measuring below the mark and take photo in the plane of bite

options.label: C
options.text: Complete description of injury as seen

questions.answerText: Complete description of injury as seen
questions.solutionHtml:
Complete description of injury as seen
  • Human bite marks are generally concentric teeth bite marks.
  • During examination of bite marks, Complete description of injury as seen is a first step.


    • KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 98.

questions.stemHtml: A 40-year-old male presents with hyperpig-mentation as shown in figure. It occurs due to:
questions.solutionHtml:
Long-term ingestion of arsenic water

Raindrop pigmentation of skin occurs due to chronic arsenic poisoning.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 538.

questions.stemHtml: Identify the fracture shown in the image:
questions.solutionHtml:
Hinge fracture

As shown in image Fracture line runs at the base of skull bone starting from the petrous ridge of one side, passing through sella turcica, and extending till lateral end of petrous ridge on other side typical for Motorcyclist/ hinge fracture.



KSN Reddy Essential Textbook of Forensic Medicine and Toxicology, 33rd edition, Page number- 243.
